findings.title: The v2 supplement lane rejects the required W1.A04 trigger witness before transition
findings.reproduction: At exact frozen R05 reviewed state 6833d6b7031769847a0006fdc2ba1af84d49dc8e, git status contains only the packet-bound, untracked and unstaged artifacts/evidence/W1.A04.B00.json witness with SHA-256 4a9d944ff95972b449b617bc384306c7023e79d31d6b427e6b6f4678cd58b22c. Calling recoveryctl.require_clean on that exact workspace fails with Untracked source exists outside the authorized recovery transition: artifacts/evidence/W1.A04.B00.json. command_supplement_start invokes require_clean with no allowed path; freeze_supplement_submission and command_supplement_review allow only their new evidence or ledger path, so they also reject the still-required witness. The submitted v2 start test patches recoveryctl.require_clean and authority/state persistence, then inspects only an in-memory GRR-0001.S01 start. The full submission/review/remediation lifecycle is a separate clean-fixture legacy v1 GRR-0001.S01 test; no test contains GRR-0002.S01. Therefore the evidence claims that the complete authorized GRR-0002.S01 7-to-8 lifecycle is green even though the real first command, and each later B01 transition, cannot run from the exact workspace R05 binds. Deleting, staging, mutating, or treating the witness as authority is not an approved transition, so criterion 4 remains infeasible without a bypass.
findings.requiredRemediation: In a strict-descendant R06 candidate, give the v2 pre-append GRR-0002.S01 lifecycle one shared exact workspace guard that permits only the unchanged, unstaged, non-authoritative artifacts/evidence/W1.A04.B00.json witness with its packet-bound SHA-256, plus the one canonical current transition artifact where applicable. Apply it consistently to supplement start, submit/resubmit, and review while denying a missing, changed, staged, authority-bearing, redirected, or duplicate witness and every unrelated staged, tracked, or untracked path. Add a real-Git end-to-end v2 GRR-0002.S01 7-to-8 start, B01 submit, independent review, and approved validation replay without mocking cleanliness, plus byte-stable denials for witness and workspace deviations. Preserve R01-R05 append-only and replace the unsupported complete-lifecycle evidence claim with exact executable results.

closures.evidence: Candidate fb88a36f4aa01de7b28f1e1ece718c75769daf1f reuses taskctl.governance_control_generation_errors in adopted state-history validation and the complete canonical taskctl.validate result in gcrctl validate/status. Prior exact R02-reader, hidden/substituted finalization, and recovery-workspace boundaries remain green.
